run_grpc_cython_server_test: run the unit test that creates a cygrpc server, registers completion queues, and shuts it down
create_cygrpc_server: create a cygrpc.Server instance and register completion queues for call and shutdown events
test_completion_queue_polling: test polling completion queues after requesting a call and shutting down the cygrpc server
add_http2_port_to_server: add an HTTP/2 port to a cygrpc server using add_http2_port with a bind address
shutdown_cygrpc_server: shutdown a cygrpc server by calling shutdown with a completion queue and tag
